_note: Mistakes index extras, keyed by the mistake ids in cards.json (the 6 tagged mistakes). g = 9.8 m/s^2, O = 16.00 g/mol.

phy-normal.explanation: You used the full weight as the normal force. On a slope the surface only pushes back against the part of the weight that presses into it, mg cos θ; the other part, mg sin θ, pulls the block along the slope.

phy-sign.explanation: You chose up as positive but kept g as +9.8 m/s². Gravity points down, so with up positive the acceleration is −9.8 m/s² for the whole flight.

chem-molar.explanation: You used the atomic mass of oxygen for oxygen gas. O₂ has two atoms per molecule, so its molar mass is 2 × 16.00 = 32.00 g/mol.

chem-ratio.explanation: You treated the reaction as 1 : 1. The coefficients in the balanced equation set the mole ratio: 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O gives 2 mol of water per mol of oxygen.
chem-ratio.rightExample: 3.0 mol O₂ × (2 mol H₂O / 1 mol O₂) = 6.0 mol H₂O

bio-mrna.explanation: You read codons straight from the DNA. Ribosomes read mRNA, which is made first by pairing with the template strand (A→U, T→A, C→G, G→C).

bio-strand.explanation: You paired the coding strand instead of copying it. The mRNA has the same sequence as the coding strand, with U in place of T; only the template strand is paired.
